unsupported_assumptions: The draft's claim that the UI 'requires an explicit on submission' is accurate only at the form level; the server accepts any POST /preference with purpose=insights&value=on, which is still an affirmative recorded choice, so this does not undermine the predicate.

No runtime fact about a specific user's toggling is needed: the predicate is a code-level gate, and the scenario's 'initially off' state is satisfied by the absence of a choices row (enabled() returns False).

anchors.explanation: enabled() selects the latest choices row for the exact (owner, purpose); no row => False, so insights default off and a promotions row cannot satisfy an insights query.
preference() restricts purposes to insights/promotions/objection and values to on/off, persists int(value=='on') with VERSION and timestamp, and cancels queued report jobs on insights off.
choices schema stores owner, purpose, value, version, at — the versioned consent record.
VERSION constant written into each choice row.
drain 'report' branch executes insights processing only when enabled(owner,'insights').
report action requires enabled(who,'insights') before queueing; promotion action uses eligible_campaign (promotions purpose only).
eligible_campaign reads only 'promotions' and 'objection' purposes, never 'insights'.
submit() validates only application fields and inserts the case; no consent/choices dependency, so core application remains available with insights off.
Separate per-purpose switch forms for insights, promotions and objection; enabling submits an explicit 'on' value.
Application form fields contain no consent checkbox requirement.
POST /preference routes purpose/value into store.preference, the entry point for the versioned choice record.

output.review_summary: Confirmed. The draft's SUPPORTED status holds against the full case. Purpose separation is enforced by the exact (owner,purpose) lookup in enabled() (store.py:0088-0090); absence of a row yields off, satisfying the 'initially off' scenario and affirmative opt-in. preference() persists a versioned, timestamped record and restricts purposes/values (store.py:0092-0098, 0042, 0011). Insights processing is gated on purpose 'insights' both at queue time (store.py:0167-0168) and at drain time (store.py:0137-0139); campaign eligibility uses only 'promotions'/'objection' (store.py:0100-0103, 0140), so a promotions choice cannot authorize insights. Core application submission (store.py:0065-0083) and the dashboard form (views.py:0031-0032) have no consent dependency. Withdrawal is honored via appended 'off' rows and report-job cancellation.
